answers.what_happened: the classifier call settled at USD 0.00008200; the world-edit draft ran 25 s to 2048 completion tokens and was refused as truncated, settled at USD 0.00136880; its repair attempt was dispatched and never settled, because the harness's HTTP client gave up at its 30 s default and its cleanup took the stack down

first_attempt.why_it_stopped: a harness defect: the client's 30 s wait is below the server's own bound for one plan, so a slow plan crashed the harness instead of being answered; no stop rule fired

changes: the plan requests wait 300 s: the server's bound for one plan on 61d99d9a is 150 s (three structured-extraction calls, each walking the role's chain of two models at 25 s) and the margin of 150 s covers the version, capability, preview and clock reads around the calls; a test holds the wait above the candidate's bound
a failure on the client's side is recorded as a result line (status 0, no execution record) and stops the run under the pre-registered unknown-cost rule, never a crash
each result line names the models that served its calls, from the execution record, and whether any was a fallback; scoring counts a fallback answer apart and never in the requested model's score
facts_corrected: the structured-extraction role's chain is Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 then deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, the second used only when the first is unavailable; the pre-registration did not state it
